overview: This Senate resolution honors Sergeant Scott Heimann of the Hays, Kansas police department, who was killed in the line of duty on September 27, 2025, while responding to a domestic violence call. It describes his roots in Hays, his police training, and his involvement with local children and the community. The Senate offers condolences to his wife, children and family, pays tribute to his sacrifice, and calls on all levels of government to support his family. It was approved on March 21, 2026.
for: Supporters say the resolution rightly honors an officer who died serving his community and recognizes his family's loss.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and doesn't change any law or spending.
